condition.notes: 5VSB resistance is fine; the next step is to confirm whether 5VSB is actually present at the ATX connector with mains applied, before diagnosing the motherboard.

next_steps.action: With the PSU plugged into mains (board side of the 24-pin connector UNPLUGGED for safety on first check), measure 5VSB at pin 9 of the PSU-side 24-pin connector.

measure.where: Pin 9 (purple wire) of the 24-pin ATX, PSU side only
measure.expected: 5.0 V +/-5% whenever the PSU is plugged into mains.
measure.safety: Measure at the PSU-side connector with the board unplugged. Never short adjacent pins with the probe; the 24-pin connector carries multiple voltages.

interpretations.then: PSU 5VSB is good. Re-plug the 24-pin to the board and re-measure 5VSB on the board side. If missing on the board side, the connector or the board's 5VSB input fuse is open.
PSU is faulty or its mains switch is off. Replace or service the PSU. Do NOT continue diagnosing the motherboard.
